title: "worked_example"
---

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
```

Reading breeding site location file
```{r}
breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(breeding_sites)
```

```{r}
glimpse(breeding_sites)
```
<chr> - character data
<dbl> - numerical data

Reading migratory connectivity file
```{r}
migration_sites <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(migration_sites))
```

```{r}
glimpse(migration_sites)
```
Pipe data to select relevant columns
```{r}
breeding_sites_selected <- breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, 
         Longitude, 
         Latitude) |>
  distinct()|>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, 
         Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(breeding_sites_selected)
```
```{r}
migration_sites_selected <- migration_sites |>
  select(Site, 
         winterLongitude, 
         winterLatitude, 
         pslon, 
         pslat, 
         iblon, 
         iblat, 
         awestlon, 
         awestlat) |>
  distinct()|>
  rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, 
         Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, 
         Stopover_Longitude = pslon, 
         Stopover_Latitude = pslat, 
         Iberian_Longitude = iblon, 
         Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
         Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, 
         Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

gt(migration_sites_selected)
```

Filtering breeding site and migration site data
```{r}
breeding_sites_exc <- breeding_sites_selected |> 
  filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(breeding_sites_exc)
```
```{r}
migration_sites_exc <- migration_sites_selected |> 
  filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(migration_sites_exc)
```

Grouping data
```{r}
migration_sites_grouped <- migration_sites_exc |> group_by(Site)
glimpse(migration_sites_grouped)
```

Making a summary
```{r}
bird_migration_summary <- migration_sites_grouped |>
  summarize(
    StopOver_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    StopOver_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
gt(bird_migration_summary)
```

Joining data frames
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(breeding_sites_exc, bird_migration_summary)
gt(combined_bird_data)
```

Convert from wide to long format
```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```

Make subset data
```{r}
spring_vals <- c("Breeding", "StopOver", "Winter")
autumn_vals <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")

spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% spring_vals)
autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_vals)
```

Export data as csv
```{r}
write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```

Calculating minimum & maximum longitude & latitude
```{r}
min_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()
max_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()
min_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()
max_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()
```

Visualizing the data
Spring data
```{r}
ggplot(spring_data, aes(
  x = Longitude,
  y = Latitude,
  color = Site,
  shape = Location_Type
)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon +2), 
    ylim = c(min_lat -2 , max_lat +2)
  ) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site)) +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Autumn data
```{r}
ggplot(autumn_data, aes(
  x = Longitude,
  y = Latitude,
  color = Site,
  shape = Location_Type
)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon +2), 
    ylim = c(min_lat -2 , max_lat +2)
  ) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site)) +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
